provenance.independence: The seven landmark readings and their tolerances were communicated to the parent before archive comparison values were supplied. This file was assembled afterwards without changing those readings or tolerances. Thin-line phase measurements were also computed before the comparison, although communicated afterwards.
provenance.scope: Paper raster only; archive values are excluded from this source feature file.
provenance.precision_warning: Coordinate transforms retain calculation precision for reproducibility, not measurement precision. Rounded amplitudes have +/-0.4 dB readout tolerance; indices have +/-5 reception tolerance.

representation.page_vector_line_purpose: Legend swatches; the plotted traces are not vector paths.
representation.limitation: Approximately 0.90 horizontal pixels per reception, thick overlapping strokes, JPEG artifacts and crossings prevent an exact recoverable native-point series.

published_labels_and_caption.difference_direction: Visually interpreted as ITA LWA II minus adapted shorted dipole. Caption names the difference but supplies no algebraic formula.
published_labels_and_caption.caption_semantics: Dipole parallel to ITA through measurement point 750; rotated by 90 degrees after point 750. ITA remains fixed for two weeks.

pixel_calibration.origin: Top-left of the extracted image, zero-based pixel coordinates; x increases right, y increases down.
pixel_calibration.zero_guide_caution: The zero guide is dark at y approximately 115-116 and must be excluded when detecting the black trace. Dark occupied pixels there are not automatically data.
pixel_calibration.calibration_systematic_caution: The regression zero is approximately y116.6, versus the dark guide center115.5, a roughly0.10 dB difference already covered by the unchanged +/-0.4 dB tolerance.

landmark_readout_policy.method: Visual center-of-stroke estimates, not outer antialias boundaries. Near pointed extrema, center is inferred several pixels inside the rounded stroke cap.
landmark_readout_policy.statistical_status: Graphical readout tolerance, not confidence interval, measurement uncertainty, or hypothesis-test significance.

thin_line_phase_diagnostics.interpretation: Very short genuine flat trace; not a long plateau or period statistic.
Isolated thin trace center; diagnostic only.

qualitative_and_textual_features.band_status: Visual descriptions, not medians, means, quantiles or exact plateau amplitudes. Thick bands combine many adjacent receptions.
qualitative_and_textual_features.coherent_pattern: Isolated positive excursion near454, negative near705, high pair near793 and812, deep negative near850, then positives near922 and978. Two antenna traces broadly co-vary through repeated fades and recoveries.
qualitative_and_textual_features.text_scope: Printed page7 attributes a step-up at point750 to the rotation and describes day/night variation. It does not provide a numerical mean step for M7AEO or dates on the plot.
qualitative_and_textual_features.correction_prose_reference: Printed page5 says the1.2 dB correction factor is applied to all SNR values in the antenna-performance comparison; preceding calibration text says the receiver-chain difference is taken into account in later comparisons.
unsupported_claims: Published statistical outlier flags or thresholds
Exact timestamps or raw spot identifiers
